records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating revenues increased $506.0 million, or 109.7%, to $967.3 million for the first quarter of 2022, as compared to the first quarter of 2021, primarily due to an increase in traffic of 57.5%, an increase in average yield of 33.1% and an increase in load factor of 5.1 pts, year over year, driven by increased air travel demand as compared to prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We experienced an increase in capacity of 46.9%, period over period, as air travel demand continued to increase compared to the same period in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the first quarter of 2022, we had a negative operating margin of 21.9%, an increase of 0.3 percentage points compared to a negative operating margin of 22.2% in the prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities in the three months ended March 31, 2022 is primarily related to cash provided from an increase in air traffic liability, an increase in other liabilities as well as higher non-cash expense of depreciation and amortization.
